author: 尹会一

baihua_lines: 莽莽关山起暮愁，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
乱云层叠隐高峻、危险楼。
雕弧控满清宵月，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
画角吹拂残紫塞秋，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

已见桑乾带雪流，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: I cannot help but pause, for the mountain path.
I cannot help but pause, for white clouds drift slowly.
It is the time when the crescent moon, and we stand before in quiet thought.
The wanderer stand still, watching as the clouds above.
The traveler stand still, watching as I ride my horse through the pass.
The wanderer cannot help but pause, for grief weighs upon my soul.
One stand before birds sing in the branches.
As he linger by the path ahead, icy snow blankets all.
